topography.project_purpose: Steer Protocol is a liquidity management platform that automates and optimizes liquidity provision for decentralized exchanges. It uses smart vaults and strategies to manage concentrated liquidity positions, aiming to maximize yields for liquidity providers.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Orchestrator coordinates the core vault logic, while registries (Vault, Strategy, Bundle, Keeper) manage the components and permissions. The SteerPeriphery provides user-facing interactions, and the GasVault handles transaction fee management, all sharing the STEER token for governance and incentives.
